key.name: dns-servers
key.description: JSON array containing DNS servers with name, ip, and visible flag.

key.name: active-dns
key.description: The IP of the currently active DNS server, or empty if using system default.

key.name: vpn-enabled
key.description: Show VPN switcher in the panel.

key.name: vpn-config-path
key.description: Absolute path to the .ovpn configuration file.

key.name: vpn-save-password
key.description: Whether to save the VPN password in keyring.

key.name: vpn-always-ask-password
key.description: Prompt for password on every connection.

key.name: network-interface
key.description: The specific network interface to apply DNS to (leave empty to try and auto-detect active connection).

key.name: vpn-dns-leak-protection
key.description: Force all DNS traffic exclusively through VPN when connected.

key.name: vpn-auto-reconnect
key.description: Automatically attempt to reconnect if the VPN drops unexpectedly.
